name: hivemind-routing-bot
description: Chain-listening bot that responds to routing requests with top-3 member matches via PFT Chatbot MCP

scripts.stop: node -e "const{readFileSync,existsSync,unlinkSync}=require('fs');const{homedir}=require('os');const{join}=require('path');const f=join(homedir(),'.hivemind-bot-loop.lock');if(!existsSync(f)){console.log('No running bot found.');process.exit(0);}const pid=Number(readFileSync(f,'utf8').trim());try{process.kill(pid,'SIGTERM');unlinkSync(f);console.log('Bot stopped (pid '+pid+')');}catch(e){if(e.code==='ESRCH'){unlinkSync(f);console.log('Stale lock removed (process was already gone).');}else throw e;}"
